file.description: Use the exact file path to edit. Supports ${env:NAME} placeholders.

mode.description: Choose overwrite to replace or create a file, append for new-line file-end additions, replace_range for existing 1-based closed line ranges, or insert_before/insert_after for anchored inserts on existing lines.

content.description: Use the complete replacement or insertion text for the selected mode. Empty content is allowed only for overwrite or replace_range, where it clears the file or deletes the selected range.

start_line.description: Use only with replace_range; this is the first existing 1-based line to replace.

end_line.description: Use only with replace_range; this is the last existing 1-based line to replace.

line.description: Use only with insert_before or insert_after; this must point to an existing 1-based anchor line. Out-of-range values return line_out_of_bounds instead of appending.

apply.description: Leave false for preview. Set true only when the previewed edit is ready to write.
